notes.title: Game release date.
notes.notes:
Greetings.
I'm happy to announce that the release date for the game is April 15.

Localization
I tried to translate the game into several languages so that more people could play it comfortably.
If you find an error in the translation or have any other questions about localization, please write here. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2399930/discussions/0/4291439052525691098/]Localization[/url]

The game story and dialog text was partially rewritten in comparison with nex fest demo.

The demo is available again on the game page. You can play the game before you buy it and make your own opinion about it.
I will be glad if you let me know if you find any bugs or anything else you think necessary.

Write here 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2399930/discussions/0/4291439052525722736/]Communication with the developer. Questions and Discussions.[/url]

if you want to tell me something personally or ask a question about the game. 
You have found a bug or do not understand how to pass some place in the game, etc.
